mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are experiencing overcast skies at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 81 degrees that feels like 85. Tonight at 10:19 PM, look to the Northwest for a spectacular five-minute viewing of the International Space Station.

In city news, Verona is continuing to push for sustainability. Residents can now utilize the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop for composting, and the city is actively replacing street lights with energy-efficient LED bulbs along Verona Avenue. Plus, water utility customers can track their usage hourly online.

Mark your calendars for several exciting local events. On July 18th, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's, or head to the Mount Horeb Art Fair. Later next week, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market returns to Hometown Junction Park on Wednesday, July 22nd.

In the police department's weekly recap, officers responded to a vehicle versus bicycle crash on Friday, July 10th, at Old PB and Whalen Road. A 24-year-old cyclist sustained minor injuries, and a local driver was cited for failing to yield the right of way.

Today's Culver's flavor of the day is the wonderfully refreshing Mint Cookie. The store is open until 10:30 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to stop by. If you miss it, tomorrow's flavor is Turtle.
